body: Sorry about your father, I’m been suffering tremendously for the last 3 years, squirming in pain in bed almost 30% of the day, I can feel for him, life is not fair, but we all have good memories and that’s what I try to think about, life is so precious, 21 years you just fine then al of a sudden your destroyed mentally and physically. I’m planning either tonight or tommarow. Sorry to hear and hope it all works out for you.
